entries.title: Genesis 45:1
segments: Then Joseph could not control himself before all those who stood by him. And he cried, Cause every man to go out from me! And no man stood before him [while] Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

entries.title: Genesis 45:2
segments: And he wept aloud. And the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard.

entries.title: Genesis 45:3
segments: And Joseph said to his brothers, I [am] Joseph. Is my father still live? And his brothers could not answer him, for they were troubled at his presence.

entries.title: Genesis 45:4
segments: And Joseph said to his brothers, Please come near me. And they came near. And he said, I [am] Joseph your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 45:5
segments: And now do not be grieved, nor angry with yourselves that you sold me here. For God sent me before you to preserve life.

entries.title: Genesis 45:6
segments: For these two years the famine [has been] in the land, and [there are] still five years in which there [will be] no plowing nor harvest.

entries.title: Genesis 45:7
segments: And God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance.

entries.title: Genesis 45:8
segments: And now you did not send me here, but God. And He has made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler over all the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 45:9
segments: Hurry and go up to my father and say to him, So says your son Joseph, God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me, do not wait.

entries.title: Genesis 45:10
segments: And you shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you shall be near to me, you and your sons and your sons' sons, and your flocks, and your herds, and all that you have.

entries.title: Genesis 45:11
segments: And I will nourish you there, for [there are] still five years of famine, lest you and your household, and all that you have, come to poverty.

entries.title: Genesis 45:12
segments: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that [it is] my mouth that speaks to you.

entries.title: Genesis 45:13
segments: And you shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. And you shall hurry and bring down my father here.

entries.title: Genesis 45:14
segments: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck and wept. And Benjamin wept upon his neck.

entries.title: Genesis 45:15
segments: And he kissed all his brothers, and wept upon them. And afterwards his brothers talked with him.

entries.title: Genesis 45:16
segments: And the report was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brothers have come. And it was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and of his servants.

entries.title: Genesis 45:17
segments: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to your brothers, Do this; load your beasts and go into the land of Canaan,

entries.title: Genesis 45:18
segments: and take your father and your households and come to me. And I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you shall eat the fat of the land.

entries.title: Genesis 45:19
segments: Now you are commanded; do this. Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

entries.title: Genesis 45:20
segments: And do not regard your stuff, for the good of all the land of Egypt [is] yours.

entries.title: Genesis 45:21
segments: And the sons of Israel did so. And Joseph gave them wagons according to the command of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

entries.title: Genesis 45:22
segments: To all of them he gave each man changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred [pieces] of silver, and five changes of clothing.

entries.title: Genesis 45:23
segments: And to his father he sent this: ten asses loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten she-asses loaded with grain and bread and food for his father by the way.

entries.title: Genesis 45:24
segments: And he sent his brothers away, and they departed. And he said to them, Do not quarrel along the way.

entries.title: Genesis 45:25
segments: And they went up out of Egypt, and came [to] the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

entries.title: Genesis 45:26
segments: And they told him, saying, Joseph [is] still alive, and he is governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he did not believe them.

entries.title: Genesis 45:27
segments: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. And when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived.

entries.title: Genesis 45:28
segments: And Israel said, [It is] enough. Joseph my son [is] still alive. I will go and see him before I die.
